page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical Intel Xeon 8369B processor cores running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 128 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention associated with hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

Given the dedicated physical core allocation and high memory density, this instance type offers a high-resource profile suited for enterprise workloads. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions it as a memory-optimized resource. It is designed for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and in-memory analytics where dedicated CPU performance and substantial memory capacity are required.
